items.notes: Queued 2026-09-23 by the registrar. METHOD (the coordinator's): for every recorded pin that names a file and a commit, or is attached to a record whose script.path and script.commit are known, compute for that file AT that commit: blob: = git rev-parse <commit>:<path>; sha256-lf16: = sha256 of the blob bytes (git stores LF); sha256-crlf16: = sha256 of the same bytes with CR restored at every line end. Report which kind matches the recorded hex prefix, or NONE. A MATCH relabels the pin by insertion (a dated bracket naming the kind). NONE marks the pin UNVERIFIED with the three computed values printed beside it, and is itself a FINDING (a pin that matches no kind of the file it names is a defect). A pin with no locatable file or commit is listed UNRESOLVABLE, never guessed. The script's output is the evidence of record. KNOWN STARTING EXAMPLES: ROUTER-CLEAN-POLICY's old 4be26482ff2a6307 (db0b653); VOTE-FRAME-CERT / TIE-MECHANICS / POSITION-INDEX-ALL's e4b5911 values 4b77b7c11805dc6c / d8c9029396367326 / e2c6108173801bb8; CERT-UNDER-FILTER's 0a92a422ee1a715e (4946646) and 409da54119dde59f (4cd0bfa); all recorded 'as relayed'.
